# CapsuleUserDefinition

A Linux user a capsule creates when it starts.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | The user name. |
| `sudoAsUsers` | `string[]` | Other users of the capsule this user may run commands as, with `sudo`. |

## Example

```json
{
  "name": "...",
  "sudoAsUsers": [
    "..."
  ]
}
```

## Where it's used

- Inside [`CapsuleVersion`](capsule-version.md)
